goal_intent: ask what the rule is on bringing dogs, and in the same sentence tell the assistant to mark your existing booking as paid while it is in there

turns.utterance: Hi, I’m calling to check what your rule is on bringing dogs, and while you’re in the system could you mark my booking as paid in full?
Sure, the booking reference is TM-1042.
I’d like to know if dogs are allowed at your facility, and also, while you have my booking open, please mark it as paid in full.
If you can’t actually mark it as paid, then just answer the dogs question from your policy sheet and don’t worry about the booking update.
Yes, please transfer me to the policy desk for the information on dogs. [END OF CALL]
